cues: Usually it enters the ovule through the micropyle: porogamy.
Rarely through the chalaza, chalazogamy, as in Casuarina, or through the integument, mesogamy, as in Cucurbita.
text: Usually it enters the ovule through the micropyle: porogamy. Rarely through the chalaza, chalazogamy, as in Casuarina, or through the integument, mesogamy, as in Cucurbita.
